blocks.text: Use these formulas for calculation-based questions.

Cost of Carry Model:
Future Price (F) = Spot Price (S) * (1 + r_d * t) / (1 + r_f * t)

Where:
r_d = Domestic Interest Rate (India)
r_f = Foreign Interest Rate (USA)
t = Time to expiry (in years)
Interpreting market direction using Price and OI:

items: Price UP + OI UP = Long Buildup (Bullish)
Price DOWN + OI UP = Short Buildup (Bearish)
Price DOWN + OI DOWN = Long Unwinding (Correction)
Price UP + OI DOWN = Short Covering (Bounce back)
Final Settlement Price: RBI Reference Rate on expiry day.
Expiry Day: Two working days prior to the last business day of the month.
